**Last updated:** 03 November 2026

These Purchase Terms & Conditions (“Terms”) apply when you purchase a Fun App access package, membership, Founding Friend package or other paid offering through the website (“Purchase”).

Please read these Terms carefully before making a Purchase. They explain what you are buying, when your agreement with the Company begins, how Fun App access and perks will work and your rights if you change your mind or if the launch is delayed.

By placing an order, you confirm that you have read and understood these Terms and agree to be bound by them.

**ABOUT FUN APP**

The website and the Purchase are operated by Fun App Ltd ("the Company").

Fun App Ltd is a company registered in England and Wales.

Company number: 17261344

Registered office: 167-169 Great Portland Street, 5th Floor, London, W1W 5PF, United Kingdom

Email: info@funapp.world

If you have any questions about your Purchase, please contact the Company using the details above.

1. **THE FOUNDING FRIEND PURCHASE**

1.1. The Purchase is a one-off payment of £249 for the Founding Friend package described on the website at the time you place your order (“Package”).

1.2. The Package is available for purchase prior to the official launch of the Service and for up to six (6) months following the official launch of the Service in the UK.

1.3. By making the Purchase, you are purchasing the access, benefits and/or perks described on the relevant Purchase page and in your order confirmation. If purchased prior to launch, you are purchasing future access and not immediate access to a fully operational version of Fun App at the time of Purchase.

1.4. The specific features, benefits, and perks included in your Package will be those stated on the Purchase page at the time you place your order.

1.5. Unless expressly stated otherwise on the Purchase page:

* the £249 payment is a one-off payment;
* there are no automatic recurring payments under these Terms;
* your Package does not guarantee access to any particular third-party venue, event, activity or service;
* any third-party benefits may be subject to availability and the applicable terms of the relevant third party; and
* your Package does not guarantee that every feature shown in versions of Fun App will remain available indefinitely.

1.6. The Company will use reasonable endeavours to provide all benefits detailed on the purchase page into the future. However, the Company cannot guarantee that every individual feature, venue perk or third-party offer will remain available indefinitely. Where specific discounts, offers or venue perks are provided through third-party Venue Partners, those offers are managed by the respective Venue Partner and may be updated, modified or substituted from time to time. The Company reserves the right to reasonably amend or replace package benefits where necessary, provided that it will not materially reduce the core value of the Package without offering an appropriate alternative or statutory remedy where required by applicable law.

1. **FUN APP LAUNCH STATUS**

2.1. Fun App is currently in development.

2.2. The Company currently anticipates launching Fun App in the UK in February 2027.

2.3. Any launch date or launch estimate the Company provides is an estimate unless expressly stated that it is a guaranteed date.

2.4. Development of an app involves technical, operational and commercial risks. Accordingly, the launch date may change.

2.5. If the launch is delayed, the Company will use reasonable efforts to keep purchasers informed of material changes to expected launch timing.

2.6. If Fun App has not launched by 12 months after purchase, you may contact the Company to request a refund of the amount paid, subject to any rights you have under applicable law.

2.7. If the Company decides that Fun App will not launch at all, it will notify affected purchasers and provide an appropriate remedy, which may include a refund of the £249 payment, subject to applicable law.

1. **WHO CAN PURCHASE A FOUNDING FRIEND MEMBERSHIP**

3.1. You must be at least 18 years old to make a Purchase, in alignment with Fun App's strict 18+ eligibility criteria, unless the Company expressly agrees otherwise. Under these circumstances, a Founding Friend below 18 years of age will not gain user access to the Service until reaching the age of 18 years.

3.2. You must provide accurate and complete information when making your Purchase.

3.3. The Purchase is intended principally for individual consumers. If you are purchasing on behalf of a business or organisation, you must contact the Company before purchasing so that applicable terms can be confirmed. Businesses or organisations purchasing a Founding Friend membership will not gain user access to the Service.

1. **FOUNDING FRIEND PRICE AND PAYMENT**

4.1. The price of the Package is £249.

4.2. The applicable price will be clearly displayed before you place your order.

4.3. Payment is processed through the Company's third-party payment provider, Stripe.

4.4. The Company does not ordinarily receive or store your full payment card details. Payment information is handled by the relevant payment provider in accordance with its own terms and privacy information.

4.5. Your order is not complete until payment has been successfully authorised and accepted by the Company.

4.6. Once your payment has been successfully received, the Company will send you an order confirmation to the email address you provided.

4.7. The Purchase is a one-off payment unless the relevant Purchase page expressly states otherwise.

1. **PLACING AN ORDER**

5.1. Before placing an order, you will be given information about the Package, including its principal characteristics and price.

5.2. Before completing your Purchase, you should check that all information you have entered is correct.

5.3. By submitting your order, you acknowledge that you are placing an order that creates an obligation to pay.

5.4. The button or equivalent function used to submit your order will clearly indicate that placing the order involves an obligation to pay.

5.5. Your order constitutes an offer to purchase the Package on these Terms.

5.6. A contract between you and the Company is formed when the Company confirms that your Purchase has been accepted and payment has been successfully received.

5.7. The Company may decline an order where, for example, payment cannot be authorised, there has been an obvious pricing or technical error, fraudulent activity is reasonably suspected or Founding Friend membership is being purchased by a business or organisation without prior approval from the Company.

1. **FUN APP ACCESS AND VERIFICATION**

6.1. Once Fun App launches (or upon purchase, if purchased during the 6-month post-launch period), eligible purchasers will receive the access and benefits included in their Package.

6.2. The Company will provide reasonable instructions for accessing Fun App when access becomes available.

6.3. You will be required to create an account and complete mandatory identity and age verification before accessing Fun App social functionality, in accordance with the Fun App User Agreement.

6.4. Your access to Fun App will be subject to the Fun App User Agreement, Acceptable Use Policy and any applicable community rules. The Company will provide those terms before or when access to relevant features is made available.

6.5. As Fun App is supplied as digital content and a digital service, facilitating in-person meetings and activities, your statutory rights under applicable consumer law are not affected by these Terms.

1. **FOUNDING FRIEND FEATURES, PERKS AND THIRD-PARTY BENEFITS**

7.1. The Package may include access to features, benefits, discounts, events, experiences, venue benefits or other perks (including Partner Venue benefits).

7.2. The Company will describe the material features and benefits included in your Package on the relevant Purchase page.

7.3. Where a perk involves an independent third-party commercial venue ("Partner Venue"), business, event organiser or service provider, that third party may impose reasonable additional conditions, including booking requirements, availability restrictions, age restrictions or rules of conduct.

7.4. The Company does not guarantee the availability of any particular Partner Venue, event, date, activity, offer or discount unless expressly stated otherwise.

7.5. If a particular Fun App perk becomes unavailable before you are able to use it, the Company may provide a reasonably comparable alternative where appropriate.

7.6. Nothing in this section limits any statutory rights you may have.

1. **CANCELLATION, REFUNDS AND RESALE OF FOUNDING FRIEND MEMBERSHIP**

**Cancellation period**

8.1. If you purchase a Founding Friend membership as a consumer online, you will generally have a statutory right to cancel your purchase within 14 days, subject to applicable law. The cancellation period and the process for exercising this right will be explained at the point of purchase.

8.2. To cancel within the applicable cancellation period, you must notify the Company using the contact details provided in these Terms (info@funapp.world) or the cancellation instructions supplied with your order.

8.3. Any refund due following a valid cancellation will be made in accordance with applicable law.

**Refunds after the cancellation period**

8.4. Once the applicable 14-day cancellation period has expired and the app has launched, you will not be entitled to a refund merely because you change your mind or no longer wish to hold your Founding Friend membership.

8.5. Clause 8.4 does not exclude or limit any refund, cancellation or other remedy to which you are entitled under applicable law, including where the Company fails to provide what was agreed or otherwise breaches its legal obligations.

8.6. Where you are entitled to a refund, the Company will make the refund in accordance with applicable law. Unless otherwise required by law, refunds will normally be made using the same payment method that you used to make the original Purchase.

**Delayed launch**

8.7. For purchases made prior to launch, if Fun App expects the app launch to be delayed materially, the Company will notify affected Founding Friend members using the contact details associated with their membership, explain the delay where reasonably possible and provide an updated expected launch date or period.

8.8. If the app has not launched within 12 months of the intended February 2027 UK launch date, you may request a refund of the amount you paid for your Founding Friend membership by contacting info@funapp.world. The Company will process any refund due under this clause within 14 days of confirming your entitlement to it, using the original payment method unless otherwise agreed.

**Failure to launch**

8.9. If the Company decides not to launch the app or determines that it will be unable to launch it, affected Founding Friend members will be notified as soon as reasonably practicable.

8.10. If the app will not launch and the Founding Friend membership and its promised benefits cannot be provided as agreed, the Company will refund the original purchase price of the membership, subject to any applicable legal requirements.

**Eligibility for resale**

8.11. A Founding Friend membership may be resold only through the resale facility authorised by Fun App Ltd and only after the app has launched and at least 12 months have elapsed from the Launch Date.

8.12. “Launch Date” means the date on which Fun App makes the app generally available for use by its intended users, as announced by the Company.

8.13. The resale price will be agreed between the seller and the buyer. The Company does not set or guarantee the resale price.

8.14. The Company will charge a commission equal to 10% of the completed resale price to cover its administrative costs, which will be fully disclosed before transaction commitment.

1. **OBLIGATIONS OF THE COMPANY**

9.1. The Company will provide the Package with reasonable care and skill where applicable.

9.2. Information that the Company provides about the Package and that you take into account when deciding whether to purchase may form part of the contract, subject to applicable law.

9.3. The Company will use reasonable efforts to deliver the benefits included in the Package in accordance with the information provided at the time of Purchase.

9.4. The Company cannot guarantee that Fun App will be completely uninterrupted or error-free once launched.

9.5. Nothing in these Terms excludes or restricts any liability or consumer right that cannot lawfully be excluded or restricted.

 10. **CHANGES TO FUN APP**

10.1. The Company expects Fun App to develop over time.

10.2. The Company may make reasonable changes to Fun App, including changes to its design, functionality, technology and supporting infrastructure.

10.3. The Company will not use this right to deprive you of the fundamental benefit for which you paid.

10.4. If a change materially affects a core element of your Package, the Company will consider what remedy is appropriate, including an alternative benefit or refund where required by applicable law.

1. **ACCOUNT AND SECURITY**

11.1. You will need to create an account and complete mandatory verification to access your Package.

11.2. You are responsible for keeping your account credentials confidential and for notifying the Company if you believe your account has been accessed without your permission.

11.3. You must not use your account or Fun App for unlawful, fraudulent or abusive purposes.

11.4. More detailed rules governing the use of Fun App are contained in the Fun App User Agreement and Acceptable Use Policy.

1. **INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY**

12.1. All intellectual property rights in Fun App, the website, branding, designs, software, content and related materials belong to the Company or its licensors unless otherwise stated.

12.2. Your Purchase gives you the personal right to access and use Fun App. It does not transfer ownership of the Company's intellectual property to you.

12.3. You must not copy, reproduce, modify, distribute, sell, licence or commercially exploit the Company's intellectual property except where expressly permitted by law or by the Company.

1. **PRIVACY**

13.1. The Company processes personal data in connection with your Purchase in accordance with its Privacy Notice.

13.2. Payment information is processed through the payment provider, Stripe, as described in the Privacy Notice and Stripe's own privacy terms.

1. **THIRD-PARTY SERVICES**

14.1. The Company may use third-party suppliers to provide elements of the website, payment processing, ID and age verification, communications, technology infrastructure and Fun App services.

14.2. Third-party services may have their own terms and privacy notices.

1. **LIMITATION OF LIABILITY**

15.1. Nothing in these Terms excludes or limits liability where it would be unlawful to do so, including liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation.

15.2. If you are a consumer, nothing in these Terms affects your statutory rights or remedies.

15.3. Subject to clauses 15.1 and 15.2, the Company will only be responsible for losses that are reasonably foreseeable and arise directly from its breach of these Terms.

15.4. The Company is not responsible for losses that arise solely from circumstances outside its reasonable control.

1. **EVENTS OUTSIDE FUN APP LTD’S CONTROL**

16.1. The Company will not be responsible for delay or failure caused by circumstances beyond its reasonable control, including major technical failures, cyber incidents, changes in law, government action, natural disasters, industrial disputes or failures of key suppliers or infrastructure.

16.2. Where such an event materially affects the delivery of the Package, the Company will use reasonable efforts to keep affected purchasers informed.

1. **COMPLAINTS**

17.1. If you have a complaint about your Purchase or the Package, please contact the Company at: info@funapp.world.

17.2. The Company will aim to acknowledge complaints promptly and deal with them within a reasonable period.

1. **CHANGES TO THESE TERMS**

18.1. The Company may update these Terms from time to time for future purchases.

18.2. The version of the Terms that applies to your Purchase will normally be the version available when you place your order, unless a change is required by law.

1. **TERMINATION**

19.1. The Company may suspend or terminate your access to Fun App if you seriously or repeatedly breach the Fun App User Agreement or Acceptable Use Policy.

19.2. Where termination occurs because of your breach, this does not automatically entitle you to a refund, subject always to your statutory rights.

1. **GOVERNING LAW**

20.1. These Terms are governed by the law of England and Wales.

20.2. The courts of England and Wales shall have exclusive jurisdiction to settle any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with these Terms, protecting your mandatory consumer rights under English and Welsh law.
